svg.title: Glide SP docking workflow for PahP - tools/glide
svg.desc: Canonical inputs, receptor and ligand preparation, box resolution and validation, receptor grid generation, Glide SP docking, extraction, results and verification.
svg.text: Glide SP docking of the PAH panel into PahP
tools/glide · branch tool/glide · Schrödinger Suite 2026-1, Glide v11.0 · canonical input commit fad5b9b · run 2026-09-02

This workflow diagram and the accompanying PDF report (REPORT.pdf) were created by Claude Opus 5. The docking run they describe was executed with Schrödinger Glide; all values come from that run's native output.
